lockup.summary: Officers, directors and holders of 5% or more of Class A shares cannot sell for 180 days after the registration statement takes effect. The company itself is also bound for 180 days after the underwriting agreement date.

what: ChainOn provides blockchain software development, cloud and hardware maintenance services to clients in Hong Kong.
proceeds: It expects net proceeds of about US$27.67 million. About 40% goes to research and technology, 20% to sales and marketing, 20% to hiring, 10% to possible investments, and 10% to working capital.
risks: Errors, bugs or security flaws in its technology services could cost it customers, harm its reputation and raise its costs.
If customers cannot complete or are unhappy with acceptance tests, projects may be delayed and it may not receive final payment.
It may need more money to run and grow, and may be unable to raise it, which could threaten its ability to continue.
If it cannot keep up with fast-changing technology in Hong Kong, its business and growth could suffer badly.
risks_note: The first 4 risk factors, summarised by AI.
